ITEM.szItemDesc: A jar filled with RDX crystals is more powerful than TNT and easier to detonate. The only drawback of RDX is its instability; it can be set off by a moderate shock.
ITEM.szBRDesc: A jar of RDX crystals are more powerful than TNT and easier to detonate. Better be forewarned, this stuff isn't too stable and can be set off by a moderate shock.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Trinitrotoluene is the second oldest and most commonly used explosive known to man - the first is dynamite. These sticks of explosives are highly stable, strawboard rolled, and contain a quarter-pound charge.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Good old reliable trinitrotoluene is the second oldest and most commonly used explosive known to man-the first is dynamite. These sticks of explosives are highly stable, strawboard rolled and contain a quarter- pound charge.

ITEM.szItemDesc: HMX is a mixture of TNT and RDX at a ratio of 50/50, by weight. Although it is not as powerful as straight RDX, it is certainly more stable.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This explosive packs a real punch. HMX is a mixture of TNT and RDX at a ratio of 50/50, by weight. Although it is not as powerful as straight RDX, it is certainly more stable.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Composition C1 is a solution of RDX and a small amount of mineral oil. This combination retains the explosive power of RDX while increasing its stability.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Composition C1 is a highly explosive solution of RDX, mixed with a small amount of mineral oil. This composition is just as effective as straight RDX, but it won't accidentally blow up in your face.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Composition C4 is a white plastic explosive that is more powerful than TNT. This plastic-covered block has a threaded-cap-well at each end. Unlike C1, its sister composition, this one's odorless.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This white plastic explosive packs a bigger punch than TNT. Composition C4 comes in a plastic-covered block with a threaded-cap-well at each end. Unlike C1, its sister composition, this one's odorless.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This anti-personnel mine is a fragmentation weapon that becomes activated when stepped on. It includes an anti-disturbance device to inhibit clearance, and a sensor that neutralizes the mine after a specified time.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Designed to stop enemies dead in their tracks, or at least slow them up a while. This anti-personnel mine is a fragmentation weapon that blows up when stepped on. It includes a built-in anti-disturbance device to inhibit clearance, and a sensor that neutralizes the minefield after a while.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A point defense land mine, with limited effect radius. Ideal for blocking small entrances.
ITEM.szBRDesc: A point defense land mine, with limited effect radius. Ideal for blocking small entrances.

ITEM.szItemDesc: It's an illuminating mine with a tripwire attached to it. Pull pressure or cutting the tripwire will ignite the flare, letting mercenaries know of enemy whereabouts.
This illuminating mine with an attached tripwire will alert mercs of nearby enemies. Pull pressure or cutting the tripwire will ignite the flare, which is followed by a loud wailing siren.
Place this small tungsten-backed plastic explosive against any door to blow the lock right off with a minimum of collateral damage.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Don't get left out in the cold just because you forgot your key. This trusty shaped-charge will solve all your problems. Place this small tungsten-backed plastique explosive against any door to blow the lock right off.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Composition C1 is a solution of RDX and a small amount of mineral oil. This combination retains the explosive power of RDX while increasing its stability. This small charge has a slightly decreased blast radius for those situations you want a more controlled explosion.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Composition C1 is a solution of RDX and a small amount of mineral oil. This combination retains the explosive power of RDX while increasing its stability. This small charge has a slightly decreased blast radius for those situations you want a more controlled explosion.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Composition C4 is a white plastic explosive that is more powerful than TNT. Unlike C1, its sister composition, this one's odorless. Compared to a regular chunk of C4, this small charge has a slightly decreased blast radius for those situations you want a more controlled explosion.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Composition C4 is a white plastic explosive that is more powerful than TNT. Compared to a regular chunk of C4, this small charge has a slightly decreased blast radius for those situations you want a more controlled explosion.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Dynamite is mainly used in the mining, quarrying, construction, and demolition industries, and it has had some historical usage in warfare. However the unstable nature of nitroglycerin, especially if subjected to freezing, has rendered it obsolete for military uses.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Dynamite is mainly used in the mining, quarrying, construction, and demolition industries, and it has had some historical usage in warfare. However the unstable nature of nitroglycerin, especially if subjected to freezing, has rendered it obsolete for military uses.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Semtex is a general-purpose plastic explosive. It is used in commercial blasting, demolition, and in certain military applications. Semtex is very similar to other plastic explosives in being highly malleable.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Semtex is a general-purpose plastic explosive. It is used in commercial blasting, demolition, and in certain military applications. Semtex is very similar to other plastic explosives in being highly malleable.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The PFM-1 is a small anti-personell land mine of Soviet production, also known as a butterfly mine.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The mine is, in essence, a plastic container containing explosive liquid. The mine is stored with a pin restraining a detonating plunger. Once the arming pin is removed, the plunger is slowly forced forward by a spring until it contacts the detonator, at which point it is armed.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This rack contains 10 Soviet made PFM-1 landmines, also known as butterfly mines. These small mines are rather nasty, as they can't be detected with a metal detector. However, they only contain a small amount of explosives.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This rack contains 10 Soviet made PFM-1 landmines, also known as butterfly mines. These small mines are rather nasty, as they can't be detected with a metal detector. However, they only contain a small amount of explosives.

ITEM.szBRDesc: Attach this baby to an explosive for real power and control. This time-delayed detonator allows you anywhere from five seconds to ten minutes to move to a location of safety before its attached explosive goes off.

This is the letter Enrico gave you. Deliver it to Miguel, leader of the rebels.
This diskette is labelled, 'Intercept's Most Wanted.' It contains confidential information on known international terrorists. It has been copied onto the laptop computer for easy reference.
Goblet of goodness, tumbler of treasures, glass of gambles. This drinking cup is a national treasure around Arulco, so don't mock it.
Taken right out from under them, these razor-sharp bloodcat claws could bring you a pretty penny in the right market.
It takes a real man to rip these babies off. Bloodcat teeth are a rare and treasured commodity in some parts of the world.
Skinning a cat is no small feat. The price on this exotic fur won't be cheap.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Dead Meat.
One unidentified, slightly decaying, human head.
The Imposter won't be imposing on anyone anymore. You're the proud owner of his slightly decaying head.
T-Rex may be gone like the dinosaurs, but be sure to hold on to his head for posterity.
Slay's been slain and all that remains is his decomposing head.
This Druggist won't be renewing any prescriptions. His head is on your chopping block now.
No one's gonna miss MOM, or her head. It's yours for the taking.
Tiffany Eddie may not have profited from using his head but you will, now that he's dead.
Bustler magazine, July issue. Features an interesting pictorial by Demi Moon and various articles no one will ever read.
This VHS camera will record and play back all your favorite memories, including embarrassing wedding moments or local magistrates in compromising positions.
Send your robot out to do your dirty work with this trusty remote control. Let him do your bidding as you sit pretty from a point of safety.
A razor-sharp claw from one of those repugnant creatures that is thankfully dead.
A rotting chunk of putrified creature flesh. At least this one's dead now.
Dead creature innards, just in time for lunch!
This is device to control something from a distance. It only has one button on it, though.
Tell time in style with this designer watch featuring a quartz crystal, swiss movement and 4 microns of beautiful platinum plating.
A small camera.
You won't miss your favorite cartoon or lose track of the football scores with this portable television. Don't leave home without it!
This is how you access your main 'bank account' where you can get your hands on cash by clicking on the different amounts followed by 'Done'. Having cash in hand is sometimes very useful.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This roll of gray, 2-inch wide heavy-duty tape is great for patching holes and keeping things together. Quite usefull for some McGyver style modifications.
This aluminum curtain rod is broken at both ends. Wonder what happened to the curtains.
This small, heavy-duty, metal coil spring is common to many household appliances.
A basic raw piece of steel, looking for a home.
Once this glue gets a grip, it doesn't let go. It will permanently stick to most substances in less than 3 minutes. Quite usefull for some McGyver style modifications.
Attach this nifty chunk of hardware to any gun barrel and watch your range soar.
A 19-foot piece of typical white string.
An empty can.
A piece of string attached to an empty soda can makes a great noise-maker when tied to a car bumper at a wedding party procession.
These round, shiny, colorful, and surprisingly heavy balls of glass are usually found in young boys' pockets. They are used mostly for amusement.
A Liquid Crystal Display ripped out of a small, portable, grayscale game machine.
Your everyday copper wire, great for tinkering with electronics or explosives of various kinds.
This contraption is essentially a LameBoy LCD rigged with copper wiring.
This Kid-tendo Fumble Pak device vibrates a video game joystick during gameplay. Warning: it may cause the player to lose his grip.
This is a piece of a hospital x-ray machine.
A pack of sugurless, spearmint flavored chewing gum. Dentists recommend chewing after every meal and between brushings.
This is a nifty looking, but sticky device made from various parts. It looks like it could light up and vibrate.
A pack of eight inch nails. Useful for building stuff made of wood.
Elasticity at its best. This rather old invention is still great for keeping a few things together.
This homemade x-ray device looks like it will actually function, flashing a vibrating x-ray pulse and crudely displaying the results on its LCD. Needs 6 batteries.
A nugget of pure silver, probably right out of Arulco's silver mines.
Just like cash, only heavier. This is a shiny, impressive nugget of pure gold, compliments of Arulco's rather meager mineral mines.
Use this tank of gas wisely. They are extremely hard to come by, here in Arulco.
These Arulcan blood diamonds will sell for some nice cash on the blackmarket.
Whoops. Somebody dropped their cash. Bad for them, good for you.
This medal seems to be what passes for a reward for service around here. Maybe there's a chocolately centre?
These might be worth something on the black market.
A torn scrap of cloth. Completely devoid of snot.
This thing just crashes with a blue screen when you boot it up. It might be the humidity. It might just be Windows.
Will we ever finally be rid of Tetris? Maybe it could be of use, if some plastic explosives were attached to it? Needs 2 batteries.
In case you need to do some administrative work, you might find this useful.
Having already delivered the hammer of justice upon its target, this empty LAW rocket launcher will live out the rest of its Dredd-ful existence as a glorified paper weight.
A used launching tube of a Panzerfaust anti-tank weapon. After firing it's warhead, it's only scrap metal now.
Sure, now that you're done with it, you're just going to throw it away. Whatever happened to recycling?

ITEM.szItemDesc: The perfect present for a kid.
Contains everything necessary to clean your gun in the field.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Even the most deadly tools of destruction need to be looked after from time to time..

ITEM.szItemDesc: This kit contains coloring products intended to alter the user’s appearance. With a set of civilian clothes this might be useful.
The Military Wood Camo Compact includes several green and brown nuanced facial paints, a mirror, and a manual on the proper use and care of your camo compact.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The Military Wood Camo Compact includes several green and brown nuanced facial paints, and a mirror. This long-lasting, non-running, facial paint can be easily removed with soap and water. The kit also includes a manual that outlines the proper use and care of your compact.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The Military Urban Camo Compact includes several grey nuanced facial paints, a mirror, and a manual on the proper use and care of your camo compact.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The Military Urban Camo Compact includes several grey nuanced facial paints, and a mirror. This long-lasting, non-running, facial paint can be easily removed with soap and water. The kit also includes a manual that outlines the proper use and care of your compact.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The Military Desert Camo Compact includes light brown, tan and white cream-based facial paint, a mirror, and a manual on the proper use and care of your camo compact.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The Military Desert Camo Compact includes light brown, tan and white cream based facial paint, and a mirror. This long-lasting, non-running, facial paint can be easily removed with soap and water. The kit also includes a manual that outlines the proper use and care of your compact.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Civilian clothes and some make-up. Ideally to stay on low profile during espionage missions.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Civilian clothes and some make-up. Ideally to stay on low profile during espionage missions.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This kit contains: antiseptic, cotton rolls, a thermometer, iodine and merthiolate vials, arm slings, safety pins, scissors, forceps, various bandages and a mini first aid manual.
ITEM.szBRDesc: From fractures to abrasions, this all-canvas kit-to-go includes everything you'll need to attend to most minor injuries. It includes: bandages, antiseptic, cotton balls, thermometers, iodine, arm slings, safety pins, scissors, and a mini first aid manual.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Aside from standard first aid supplies, this kit includes: a suture set and scissors, prep pads, a scalpel, Kelly forceps, tweezers, pain killers, anesthetic, antibiotics, a pen light, and a surgical manual.
ITEM.szBRDesc: It's a first aid kit and then some. Aside from standard first aid supplies, this kit includes: a suture set, prep pads, suture scissors, a scalpel, Kelly forceps, tweezers, anesthetic, pain killers, antibiotics, a pen light, and the "Emergency War Surgery" manual.

ITEM.szItemDesc: An easy to use emergency bandage.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This Traumapack contains a couple of emergency bandages that are easy to use.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Lighter and slightly more compact than a regular Medical Kit, the Response Kit still contains all the necessary items to perform field surgery, just in lower quantities.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Lighter and slightly more compact than a regular Medical Kit, the Response Kit still contains all the necessary items to perform field surgery, just in lower quantities.

ITEM.szItemDesc: These simple gloves protect you from infection by contact with infected persons.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Useful for doctors. Not useful in snow.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This simple mask protects you somewhat from infection by airborne diseases.
ITEM.szBRDesc: If you are doctor or live in an Asian megacity, you will need these.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Sturdy working gloves, if you need carry dangerous or heavy stuff around, a must have.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Sturdy working gloves, if you need carry dangerous or heavy stuff around, a must have.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This kit includes: a wide range of screwdrivers, ratchets, pliers, clamps, clasps, a hammer and a sewing kit.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This kit offers every tool you'll need to repair most combat items. A wide range of screwdrivers, ratchets, pliers, clamps, and clasps are included, as well as a hammer and sewing kit.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This small tool kit for field service contains all necessary tools for emergency repairs in the field.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This small tool kit for field service contains all necessary tools for emergency repairs in the field.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This versatile tool combines a knife, a lockpick kit, wire cutters, a screw driver, scissors, a can opener, a cork screw and several other useful tools you never heard of.
ITEM.szBRDesc: We can think of about 600 reasons why this much-applauded multi-tool belongs on your belt. But don't worry, well just stick to the most important ones here. Like profound versatility and a level of rock-solid design and construction that pleases the eye and satisfies the soul.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This knife has a hole in the blade that works in conjunction with the end of the sheath to facilitate wirecutting.
Your average everyday handyman's wire cutters.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Your average everyday handyman's wire cutters. Extremely useful and versatile-don't leave home without them!

ITEM.szItemDesc: This top-grain cowhide leather zipped case offers expert lockpicking tools including: picks, shims, tension wrenches, warded master keys, a broken key extractor, and a palm-key press.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The perfect solution for getting behind locked doors and into security safes. This kit offers expert lockpicking tools, including: picks, shims, tension wrenches, warded master keys, a broken key extractor, and a palm-key press, all in a top-grain cowhide leather zipped case.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Don't drink!
Don't drink! There is also some duct tape sticking on the bottle.
A mix of gasoline and oil. You'd better not use this to refill your car. But maybe there is another use for it.
This emergency flare has been modified with a detonator. All you need now is some kind of trip wire to get a trip flare.
Attaching a detonator to a walkman may seem stupid, but once you got rid of unneccessary parts you got a basic alarm trap. All you need now is some kind of trip wire.
This shell casing can be combined with a variety of 40mm grenades to allow firing the grenades with a 40mm commando mortar.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This shell casing can be combined with a variety of 40mm grenades to allow firing the grenades with a 40mm commando mortar.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This fragmentation body can be used with a DM51 handgrenade to add a devestating area effect.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This fragmentation body can be used with a DM51 handgrenade to add a devestating area effect.

ITEM.szItemDesc: As German stick grenades had only a thin steel casing surrounding the explosive charge, they relied principally on blast for effect. The addition of a Splitterring to a standard stick grenade gave it greatly increased fragmentation ability.
ITEM.szBRDesc: As German stick grenades had only a thin steel casing surrounding the explosive charge, they relied principally on blast for effect. The addition of a Splitterring to a standard stick grenade gave it greatly increased fragmentation ability.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Someone has a put a detonator on this steel tube. What could this be used for?
A canister of ammonium nitrate, which is commonly used in agriculture as a high-nitrogen fertilizer. Perfect if you want your wheat to grow well.
A can of Esso brand oil. Funny, you don't remember seeing any Esso stations around here.
A glass jar filled with some marbles.
A glass jar filled with some nails.

Toilet cleaners tend to be fairly poisonous, and need to be treated with care since they contain disinfectants which can cause skin irritations. This brand uses a fairly high concentration of Sodium Hypochlorite.

Sodium hypochlorite is a chemical compound with the formula NaClO. It is composed of a sodium and hypochlorite. It may also be viewed as the sodium salt of hypochlorous acid. It is commonly known as bleach or liquid bleach.
Hydrochloric acid is a clear, colorless, highly pungent solution of hydrogen chloride (HCl) in water. It is a highly corrosive, strong mineral acid with many industrial uses.
A jar with Hydrochloric acid. This acid is a clear, colorless, highly pungent solution of hydrogen chloride (HCl) in water. It is a highly corrosive, strong mineral acid with many industrial uses.
Sulfur trioxide is the chemical compound with the formula SO3. In the gaseous form, this species is a significant pollutant, being the primary agent in acid rain.
A jar with Sulfur trioxide. This chemical compound with the formula SO3 is a significant pollutant, being the primary agent in acid rain.
From the perspective of applications and chemical literature, the most important form of elemental phosphorus is white phosphorus, often abbreviated as WP.
A jar filled with white phosphorous. This only needs some kind of resilient elastomere to form a nasty incendiary device.
This satellite transmitter enables a laptop computer to connect to the Internet from anywhere in the world. N.B. Works with operating systems other than Windows.
A sushi-western classic. All Hell breaks loose in a small mid-western town when a full team of eight Clydesdales knock over the beer wagon and get into the suds.
Not to be confused with the American film Wild, Wild West, which was a dud, this sushi-western, starring Will Smithero and Tex Colburn, is a hilarious romp through time.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A combination of a reflex sight and a 3x scope.

ITEM.szBRDesc: Originally developed for the XM-8. The Integrated Sightning Module combines a high power Laser Aiming Module with a quality scope and a red dot sight.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A combination of a red-dot sight with a high power aiming laser (including IR).

ITEM.szBRDesc: The standard sight of the I.M.I. Tavor, the ITL Multi-purpose Aiming Reflex Sight combines an advanced reflex sight with a high-power laser device.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A combination of the Burris Speeddot and the AR scope.

The universal bipod fits most sniper and assault rifles, as well as light machine guns. Made from a die-cast aluminum, it has a coated matte finish.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Every sensible mercenary packs one of these universal bipods. It fits most sniper and assault rifles, as well as light machine guns. Made from a die-cast aluminum, it has a coated matte finish. Its legs can easily be folded up when not in use.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This unique upgrade kit can be used to upgrade any standard kevlar helmet to its stealth ops counterpart.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Upgrade your helmet today! From standard kevlar helmet to high-tech stealth operations head protection in no time! This kit includes all the necessary tools for such conversion.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This upgrade kit contains the necessary components and tools to convert a common kevlar vest into the state-of-the-art Stealth Ops vest.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Need a suit for the next stealth mission? If you already have a standard kevlar vest, all you need is this upgrade kit and a few minutes of your time!

ITEM.szItemDesc: All you ever need to upgrade your kevlar leggings to those used by stealth operatives.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Making too much noise while walking around? With this upgrade kit you'll mute your kevlar leggings forever.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This upgrade kit contains the necessary components and tools to convert a kevlar, guardian or twaron vest into camouflaged recon vest.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Make a light, camouflaged recon vest today! With this upgrade kit it's easier than ever!

ITEM.szItemDesc: All you ever need to upgrade your kevlar or twaron leggings to those used by recon operatives.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Uncomfortable leggings? No camouflage pattern? With this upgrade kit your kevlar or twaron leggings might become first class recon gear!

ITEM.szItemDesc: This upgrade kit contains the necessary components and tools to convert a kevlar, guardian, twaron, spectra or dyneema vest into field operative vest.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Spending too much time outside? Upgrade your vest using this kit and enjoy more comfort and protection than ever!

ITEM.szItemDesc: All you ever need to upgrade your kevlar, twaron, spectra or dyneema leggings to those used by field operatives.
ITEM.szBRDesc: No matter if you're a professional merc or a kid spending too much time playing outside - this upgrade kit is all your leggings need.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This upgrade kit contains the necessary components and tools to convert a kevlar, guardian, twaron, spectra or dyneema vest into a desert camo vest.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This kit easily converts your regular protective vest into a desrt camo vest.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This kit contains all you need to upgrade your kevlar, twaron, spectra or dyneema leggings to convert them into desert camo variants.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This kit contains all you need to upgrade your kevlar, twaron, spectra or dyneema leggings to convert them into desert camo variants.

ITEM.szItemDesc: One time use chemical break lights are an extremely convenient and portable light source. Simply break 'n' throw to brighten your way.
ITEM.szBRDesc: These one time use chemical break lights will certainly help to lighten up those dreary night missions. Stock up on these handy little babies 'cause you'll never know when you'll need them. Simply break 'n' shake to brighten your way.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A flare normally used for emergency purposes.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Brighter than chemical lightsticks, but also comparatively short-lived, these flares can light up the night for you.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A flare normally used for emergency purposes. There is some duct tape on it.
Soviet RSP Flares are brighter alternative to chemical lightsticks.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Soviet RSP Flares are brighter alternative to chemical lightsticks.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A very small and reliable fragmentation grenade.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The V40 grenade is spherical in shape, very light weight and approximately only the size of a golf-ball, therefore considerable amounts of this grenade can be carried.. You won't find a smaller hand grenade in our stock.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This small TNT loaded grenade was designed to ensure a significant throwing range and effective fragmentation. It has been proven to provide good lethal coverage.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This small grenade was developed for maximum throwing range combined with effective fragmentation. The body is loaded with TNT and provides good lethal coverage. Because of its size, even women find this grenade an easy toss.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A compact and small fragmentation grenade that will spread its shrapnel over a wide area.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The HG 85 consists of a plastic body, an inner liner carrying the preformed fragments, and a filling of PentaErythritol TetraNitrate (PETN) high explosive. Despite its compact size it packs quite a punch and scatters its fragments over an area of up to 50 meters.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Small and compact Russian offensive mini grenade. Very lethal in a very limited area of effect.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The hard to get RGN hand grenade is an offensive Russian fragmentation hand grenade. The grenade shell consists of two internally serrated aluminium hemispheres. The fragments produced by the grenade generate a lethal radius of between 5 and 20 meters

ITEM.szItemDesc: Small and compact Russian defensive mini grenade. Very lethal in a limited area of effect.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The hard to get RGO hand grenade is a defensive Russian fragmentation hand grenade. It consists of a double layered aluminium pre-fragmented body. The fragments produced by the grenade generate a lethal radius of between 6 and 30 meters

ITEM.szItemDesc: The DM51 is a German handgrenade that can be combined with a fragmentation body or used as a small offensive grenade.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The DM51 is a German handgrenade that can be combined with a fragmentation body or used as a small offensive grenade.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Index 2217
Index 2218
Index 2219
Index 2220
An old, but still extremely effective US hand grenade. The MK2 is a defensive grenade packed with TNT, and delivers a wide fragmentation radius. Uses a pull-ring, pressure-released firing trigger.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This "pineapple" may be older than you are, but it's no less effective on the modern battlefield. Jam packed with TNT, this pressure-released firing device with pull-ring provides great lethal coverage. Stop 'em dead in their tracks, every time.

ITEM.szItemDesc: While it may not be an ideal design for most efficient function, due to the offset detonator, which causes asymmetrical fragmentation, it is simple, rugged and effective.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Without a doubt the most successful hand grenade of the 20th Century, having the longest continuous service life of any other type. The No.36M Mk.I remained the standard grenade of the British Armed Forces and was manufactured in the UK until 1972.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The M61 is a Vietnam War era hand grenade. It is basically an improved MK2 defensive grenade.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The M61 is a Vietnam War era hand grenade. It is basically an improved MK2 defensive grenade. If you liked the "pineapple", you'll love the lemon.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Soviet-style fragmentation grenade. Handle with care, these things are pretty volatile.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The RGD-5 is an affordable post World War II Russian anti-personnel fragmentation grenade. The design dates from the late 1950s. It is still in service in many of Russia's former client states.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The F1 is an anti-personnel fragmentation grenade with a considerable are of effect.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This is the updated version of the Soviet World War II fragmentation grenade.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A very reliable German hand grenade. The casing of the grenade is thick and shock resistant. Its plastic casing is filled with 3.800 steel balls, that will scatter over a significant area.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This M-DN 11 Fragmentation Grenade was designed by Diehl of Germany to replace DM-51 grenades employed by German forces. Due to the relatively high price, only a very limited amount has been used by German GSG-9 and KSK forces.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This fragmentation handgrenade is used by the Bundeswehr. The fragmentation body can be easily removed, if you need only the explosive charge.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This fragmentation handgrenade is used by the Bundeswehr. The fragmentation body can be easily removed, if you need only the explosive charge.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Very effective hand grenade with a limited area of effect.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The MK3A2 offensive hand grenade is a concussion grenade designed to produce casualties during close combat while minimizing danger to friendly personnel.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The potato masher is a very effective offensive grenade. Due to its odd shape you may find it difficult to store them.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Rare collectors item! We just got our hands on some very hard to find vintage WW 2 German stick grenades.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This grenade is improved with a fragmentation ring for a higher blast radius.
ITEM.szBRDesc: These M24 Grenades are modified with a fragmentation ring for a higher blast radius.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A chunk of steel, a detonator and a small C1 charge form a nice little pipebomb. Use on your own risk.
A homemade devestating little explosive device.
Take some marbles, a jar and a chunk of C1 plastic explosives and you get a nice little homemade handgrenade.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Tried and true by the boys in blue. This American pistol is the most common police service revolver in the world.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The standard Smith&Wesson military and police double-action revolver is ideal for both self-defense and offensive purposes. When the mainspring ages however, the gun is prone to light hammer blows.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A .38 Special revolver with a slightly longer barrel.
ITEM.szBRDesc: A .38 Special revolver with a slightly longer barrel.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This longbarrel version of the .38 Korth Revolver is quite accurate and reliable.
The preferred weapon of Dirty Harry's little brother, this Belgian revolver has found its way into many American police holsters.
A very sturdy revolver, the Python has a reputation for accuracy.
Mostly based on S&W revolvers, but with a few features of its own, the MR-73 is the backbone of Manurhin's revolver production.

Another French quality revolver.

ITEM.szBRDesc: Though canceled by the US Military, we're sure you'll love the CAWS! We've just received a limited shipment of these experimental fully automatic shotguns, and their special ammo. Turn your enemies into a gory mess at 240RPM. Comes with built-in telescopic sight.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The experimental Close Assault Weapons System from HK. It fires special 12 gauge belted brass-case ammunition developed by Olin/Winchester that delivers superior range to conventional shotguns. It is capable of semi and fully-automatic operation and has been fitted with the G36 optics.

The experimental Close Assault Weapons System from HK. It fires special 12 gauge belted brass-case ammunition developed by Olin/Winchester that delivers superior range to conventional shotguns. It is capable of semi and fully-automatic operation and has been fitted with a G36 rail kit to allow more modern attachments.
A heavy calibre pump action combat shotgun that uses 18.5x76mm rounds originally developed for the HK Close Assault Weapon System.
ITEM.szBRDesc: A side product of the CAWS project, this combat shotgun uses the same calibre as the HK CAWS. If your regular 12 gauge doesn't cut it anymore, try the nasty 18.5x76mm rounds.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Due to a slight adjustment in the firing mechanism, this M79 Grenade Launcher is more like a direct fire shotgun, using 40mm Buckshot ammunition.
This M79 Grenade Launcher has been cut down considerably.
A heavy multi-shot grenade launcher for 4 40mm grenades, 3 of them stored in the tubular magazine.
A shortbarreled standalone M203 grenade launcher mounted to a pistolgrip and retractable buttstock.
A standalone M203 grenade launcher mounted to a pistolgrip and buttstock. Use this firing mode to fire 40mm buckshot.
The Milkor MGL six-shot 40mm grenade launcher is the world's first mass-produced multi-shot, rapid-fire 40mm hand-held weapon.
A double barreled 40mm grenade launcher system.
Just your standard 18th century hand mortar with a stubby brass barrel and JOURSON engraved on the lock. Worth a fortune on the collector's market.
A virtual mute in a riotous crowd of gunpowder-driven killing machines. Use this dart gun to get the job done without even waking up old man Death himself.
ITEM.szBRDesc: A virtual mute in a riotous crowd of gunpowder-driven killing machines. Use this dart gun to get the job done without even waking up old man Death himself.

ITEM.szItemDesc: If you need to put a bear to sleep, try one of these.
ITEM.szBRDesc: If you need to put a bear to sleep, try one of these. Comes with a default small scope.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The Metal Storm Pistol uses pre-stacked ammunition in 4 barrels, resulting in a high rate of fire.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The Metal Storm Pistol uses pre-stacked ammunition in 4 barrels, resulting in a high rate of fire.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Wet or dry, Metal Storm's Surf Zone SMG will not jam. Just be sure to have someone good with electronics around to fix it.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Metal Storm's obscene rate of fire is always an attention grabber. Featherweight reliable mass firepower sells it. It makes sense that the Surf Zone is secured by an electronic fingerprint lock.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A true Rocketeer pistol, the Gyrojet fires 12mm rockets. It lacks a removable magazine; rounds have to be pushed down from the open "bolt" and then held in place by quickly sliding a cover over them on the top of the gun.
ITEM.szBRDesc: A true Rocketeer pistol, the Gyrojet fires 12mm rockets. It lacks a removable magazine; rounds have to be pushed down from the open "bolt" and then held in place by quickly sliding a cover over them on the top of the gun.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Manufactured between 1962 and 1970, the Gyrojet Carbine fires a 13mm spin-stabilized solid fuel rocket in lieu of a traditional cartridge. Operating at a very low pressures and not needing a sophisticated cartridge ejection system, the carbine is made from very light alloys.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Manufactured between 1962 and 1970, the Gyrojet Carbine fires a 13mm spin-stabilized solid fuel rocket in lieu of a traditional cartridge. Operating at a very low pressures and not needing a sophisticated cartridge ejection system, the carbine is made from very light alloys.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A modern precision crossbow with scope and 5 bolt clip for fast reloading, custom made for the ambitious marksman.
ITEM.szBRDesc: A modern precision crossbow with scope and 5 bolt clip for fast reloading, custom made for the ambitious marksman.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The M134 Minigun is a 7.62 mm, six-barreled machine gun with a high rate of fire. It's far too heavy and unwieldy to be carried around by a person and rather designed for mobile weapon platforms.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The M134 Minigun is a 7.62 mm, six-barreled machine gun with a high rate of fire. It's far too heavy and unwieldy to be carried around by a person and rather designed for mobile weapon platforms.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This very light mortar closes the range gap between grenade launchers and 60mm commando mortars. Can use either NATO or VOG grenades in a special shell casing.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This very light mortar closes the range gap between grenade launchers and 60mm commando mortars. Can use either NATO or VOG grenades in a special shell casing.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The Commando Mortar is a 60mm caliber mortar, slightly lighter and faster than the M224.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The Commando Mortar is a 60mm caliber mortar, slightly lighter and faster than the M224.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The M224 is a 60mm caliber lightweight mortar with a finned barrel, sight, M7 base plate, and a bipod. It was built to handle HE bombs.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Commonly referred to as the battalion commander's artillery, the M224 mortar is a must-have for the serious mercenary commandant. It is a 60mm caliber lightweight mortar with a finned barrel, sight, M7 base plate and bipod, that was built to specifically accommodate HE shells.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The ordnance SBML two-inch mortar, or more commonly, the "two-inch mortar", was a British mortar issued to the British Army and the Commonwealth armies, that saw use during the Second World War and later.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The ordnance SBML two-inch mortar, or more commonly, the "two-inch mortar", was a British mortar issued to the British Army and the Commonwealth armies, that saw use during the Second World War and later.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Compared to the XM29, the XM25 dispenses with the complexity and weight of having an integrated Kinetic Energy weapon, and is purely a magazine fed, multi-shot grenade launcher.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Who needs bullets when you have grenades? The XM-25 is the stand alone magazine fed grenade system spawned by the revamped US OICW program. To the enemies of freedom, there is still nowhere to hide. Comes with a Grenade Launcher red dot sight.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The literal German translation is "Distress Signal Tool". It is marketed abroad as the Emergency Flare Launcher or EFL. With a five shot magazine, the EFL is a handy little flare launcher.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The literal German translation is "Distress Signal Tool". It is marketed abroad as the Emergency Flare Launcher or EFL. With a five shot magazine, the EFL is a handy little flare launcher.

ITEM.szItemDesc: About the size of a large revolver, this Flare Gun can fire 20mm grenades.
ITEM.szBRDesc: About the size of a large revolver, this Flare Gun can fire 20mm grenades.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The M64 is a double barrel, breech loaded 20mm grenade launcher.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The M64 is a double barrel, breech loaded 20mm grenade launcher.

ITEM.szItemDesc: One hit from this Light Anti-Tank Weapon is better than a one way ticket to Judgement Day. No judge, no jury, and all executioner.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The M72A2 Light Anti-Tank Weapon is a light-weight shoulder-fired rocket launcher which can penetrate a foot of tank armour or destroy small battlefield fortifications. A one-shot weapon of awesome destructive power.

ITEM.szItemDesc: WARNING: DO NOT AIM AT FACE.
ITEM.szBRDesc: For the times when flowers just don't cut it: say it with high explosive rocket propelled grenades.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A top of the line RPG launcher with improved range and accuracy.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The RPG-27 Tavolga is a further development of rocket propelled grenade launchers, and is endowed with increased range and accuracy.

ITEM.szItemDesc: With this baby, you can turn a pool party into a BBQ. Literally.
ITEM.szBRDesc: With the RPO-A Shmel thermobaric rocket launcher, you can turn a pool party into a BBQ. Literally. NEWS UPDATE: We now stock the improved Shmel-M.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The Panzerfaust is a cheap, recoilless German anti-tank weapon of World War II. It consists of a small, disposable preloaded launch tube firing a high explosive anti-tank warhead, that can easily be operated by a single soldier.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The Panzerfaust is a cheap, recoilless German anti-tank weapon of World War II. It consists of a small, disposable preloaded launch tube firing a high explosive anti-tank warhead, that can easily be operated by a single soldier.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The AT4 is one of the most common light anti-tank weapons in the world.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The AT4 is an 84-mm unguided, portable, single-shot recoilless smoothbore weapon built in Sweden by Saab Bofors Dynamics. The AT4 is one of the most common light anti-tank weapons in the world.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The Rocket Propelled Grenade, or RPG, is a cheap, single-shot weapon. It's main purpose to to provide an inexpensive albeit devastating weapon against soft targets.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The Rocket Propelled Grenade, or RPG, is a cheap, single-shot weapon. It's main purpose to to provide an inexpensive albeit devastating weapon against soft targets.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The Type 69, like its predecessor the RPG-7, is one of the most popular infantry anti-tank and general support weapons in the world. It is robust, cheap, easy to operate and effective.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The Type 69, like its predecessor the RPG-7, is one of the most popular infantry anti-tank and general support weapons in the world. It is robust, cheap, easy to operate and effective.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The RPG-16 was developed in the 1960s, and has better range than the RPG-7.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Once your enemy sees your packing the kind of firepower an RPG provides, have mercy on him and let him run away in fear. Or not.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The Shoulder-launched Multipurpose Assault Weapon (SMAW) is a shoulder-launched rocket weapon with the primary function of being a portable assault weapon and a secondary anti-armor rocket launcher.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The Shoulder-launched Multipurpose Assault Weapon (SMAW) is a shoulder-launched rocket weapon with the primary function of being a portable assault weapon and a secondary anti-armor rocket launcher.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Also referred to as the "Stovepipe", the innovative bazooka was amongst the first-generation of rocket propelled anti-tank weapons used in infantry combat.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Also referred to as the "Stovepipe", the innovative bazooka was amongst the first-generation of rocket propelled anti-tank weapons used in infantry combat.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The Carl-Gustaf recoilless rifle is a devestating anti-tank, anti-personnel weapon, firing 84mm rockets.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The Carl-Gustaf recoilless rifle is a devestating anti-tank, anti-personnel weapon, firing 84mm rockets.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Panzerschreck was the popular name for the Raketenpanzerbüchse (abbreviated to RPzB), an 88 mm calibre reusable anti-tank rocket launcher developed by Nazi Germany in World War II.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Panzerschreck was the popular name for the Raketenpanzerbüchse (abbreviated to RPzB), an 88 mm calibre reusable anti-tank rocket launcher developed by Nazi Germany in World War II.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The M202 is a multishot rocket launcher.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The M202 is a multishot rocket launcher.

ITEM.szItemDesc: If quick passage through a brick wall or a cluster of bad guys is what you need, the M79, a 40mm US grenade launcher from the Vietnam era, will terminate your troubles every time.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Known for its accuracy at longer ranges, the 40mm M79 Grenade Launcher is not your average rifle grenade. This breech loaded, single shot, break-open weapon is usually fired from the shoulder. It features a blade foresight and a folding-leaf adjustable rear sight.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This M79 Grenade Launcher has been cut down considerably.
A heavy multi-shot grenade launcher for 4 40mm grenades, 3 of them stored in the tubular magazine.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This multi-shot grenade launcher for 40mm grenades is a bit on the heavy side of things, but if you need serious fire power, grab one of these.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A shortbarreled standalone M203 grenade launcher mounted to a pistolgrip and retractable buttstock.
ITEM.szBRDesc: KAC decided to copy Colt in making some gear that makes the M203 launcher usable without a rifle. We have decided to stock the shortbarreled version.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A standalone M203 grenade launcher mounted to a pistolgrip and buttstock.
ITEM.szBRDesc: After the success the HK69 grenade pistol had with the Special Forces community, Colt decided to issue a standalone grenade launcher as well.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The Milkor MGL six-shot 40mm grenade launcher is the world's first mass-produced multi-shot, rapid-fire 40mm hand-held weapon.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The Milkor MGL six-shot 40mm grenade launcher is the world's first mass-produced multi-shot, rapid-fire 40mm hand-held weapon. The MGL can fire six shots in less than three seconds, making it essential in dealing with ambush situations and in urban warfare.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A double barreled 40mm grenade launcher system.
ITEM.szBRDesc: What's better than a 40mm grenade? Two 40mm grenades. Double your gun, double your fun with the Sage Deucce double barrel launcher system.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Light-weight, retractable 40mm Russian grenade launcher for the grenadier in your squad. The RGM Kastet fires 40mm VOG-25 and VOG-25P grenades.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Living proof that the "Russian concussion" wasn't just the nick-name of the foreign exchange student you dated in college. The RGM Kastet fires 40mm VOG-25 and VOG-25P grenades.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This Russian multi-shot grenade launcher was apparently influenced by the Milkor.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This Russian multi-shot grenade launcher was apparently influenced by the Milkor.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This Russian made pump-action grenade launcher fires 43mm ordnance.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Compact and light-weight, this launcher can quickly dispense a variety of deadly payloads.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The Metalstorm Launcher System is a standalone launcher for metalstorm grenades. Capable of full automatic fire to fire a complete stack in one burst.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The Metalstorm Launcher System is a standalone launcher for metalstorm grenades. Capable of full automatic fire to fire a complete stack in one burst.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The ADS Launcher is a lightweight integral underbarrel grenade launcher for 40mm VOG grenades.
The built-in launcher of the SSW comes with a 4 round tube magazine.
The standard M203 is intended for attachment to the M16A1, M16A2 and M16A3 rifles, and utilizes a 12 inch rifled barrel. The M203 unmodified to an A1/A2 series will not fit on the M4 Carbine series.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The standard M203 is intended for permanent attachment to the M16A1, M16A2 and M16A3 rifles, and utilizes a 12 inch rifled barrel. The M203 unmodified to an A1/A2 series will not fit on the M4 Carbine series.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The Product Improved version of the M203 fits a lot of rifles, thanks to some ingenious adapters that come with the launcher. Special foregrip available. Cannot shoot grenades of more than standard length.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Everyone wanted a M203, and now they can. The much improved M203PI does not only work with the M16 and M4, but with several European and some Israeli rifles as well.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The Anbau-Granatwerfer 36 is an underbarrel grenade launcher for most of HK's modern rifles. Does not fit the short G36C, though.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Need some extra firepower on your G36? This oversized pistol does the trick. Can launch all standard NATO 40mm grenades.

ITEM.szItemDesc: FN Herstal's underbarrel grenade launcher for the SCAR. Obviously developed from the launcher for the F2000.
ITEM.szBRDesc: FN Herstal developed their launcher for the F2000 some more to fit it on the SCAR. Will fire grenades of any length and can use future medium velocity grenades.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A little known underbarrel grenade launcher for Heckler & Kochs older rifles. The drop down barrel can take NATO grenades of any length.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This is the German equivalent to the American M203 underbarrel grenade launcher. The HK79 is slightly longer and will fit only on older HK rifles. It can fire all NATO 40mm grenades on the market today or tomorrow.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The FN F2000 comes with an integrated 40mm grenade launcher.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The FN F2000 comes with an integrated 40mm grenade launcher.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Operating like a computer triggered Roman candle, Metal Storm's grenade system is perhaps the lightest and least bulky complete multi-shot launcher around.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The AICW comes with an integrated 40mm grenade launcher.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The XM-29 OICW comes with an integrated 20mm grenade launcher.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The XM-29 OICW comes with an integrated 20mm grenade launcher.

ITEM.szBRDesc: The GP-25 is a lightweight underbarrel grenade launcher for 40mm VOG grenades.

ITEM.szBRDesc: An improved model of the GP-25 Kostyor, the GP-30 Obuvka features a sighting recticle and a recoil buffer to protect the rifle to which it is attached. The GP-30 fires 40mm VOG-25 and VOG-25P grenades.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A rock is what you've got in your head if you don't know what one is.
A rock usually associated with a roll is a form of modern music that tends to be loud and a preferred choice of adolescents.
Just a regular sized baseball.
The most renowned silent, fast projectile weapon of Ninpo Taijutsu.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Silent, swift, and effective with razor-sharp edges.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This finely balanced steel throwing knife brings new meaning to the expression killing them softly. Or, in this case, silently.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This heavy steel throwing knife brings new meaning to the expression killing them softly. Or, in this case, silently.
ITEM.szBRDesc: For experienced knife-throwers only! This heavy blade is guaranteed to punch even the heaviest of armor, but its weight makes it a little awkward for newbies.

ITEM.szItemDesc: From Ancient Japan to the Anime and video games of the present, Kunai knives have remained a trusted weapon of choice for ninjas.
ITEM.szBRDesc: From Ancient Japan to the Anime and video games of the present, Kunai knives have remained a trusted weapon of choice for ninjas.

ITEM.szItemDesc: An assortment of plumbing fittings.

ITEM.szBRDesc: A boomerang is a tool, typically constructed as a flat air foil that, when thrown, is designed to spin about an axis perpendicular to the direction of its flight.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A tasty apple.

ITEM.szBRDesc: Ultimately based on a medieval type of single-edged weapon, the sabre was adopted as the weapon of heavy cavalry in Early Modern warfare.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This is the pride of the samurai.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This is a rare Japanese masterpiece, decorated with dragons. It can chop through bamboo like a hot knife through butter!

ITEM.szBRDesc: A backsword is a type of European sword characterised by having a straight single-edged blade and a hilt with a single-handed grip.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The blade designs of falchions varied widely through the ages. They almost always included a single edge with a slight curve on the blade towards the point on the end and most are also affixed with a quilloned crossguard for the hilt in the manner of the contemporary arming swords.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The blade designs of falchions varied widely through the ages. They almost always included a single edge with a slight curve on the blade towards the point on the end and most are also affixed with a quilloned crossguard for the hilt in the manner of the contemporary arming swords.

ITEM.szBRDesc: Messer was a term for the class of single-edged bladed weapons, deriving from the medieval falchion and preceding the modern sabre.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A pirates' weapon of choice.
ITEM.szBRDesc: A cutlass is a short, broad sabre or slashing sword, with a straight or slightly curved blade sharpened on the cutting edge, and a hilt often featuring a solid cupped or basket-shaped guard. It was a common naval weapon.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Yatagans consist of a single-edged blade with a marked forward curve and a hilt formed of two grip plaques attached through the tang, the end of the hilt being shaped like large ears.

ITEM.szBRDesc: A Bayonet-Knife for use on the 5.56 mm. NATO caliber M16 assault rifle. Also used on some U.S. issue combat shotguns, such as the Remington 870 and the Mossberg 500.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A small, well-balanced knife.

ITEM.szItemDesc: If ever there was a fighting knife that just looks scary, it is the Fairbairn-Sykes Commando Knife. It is a double bladed dagger design, with a foil type grip and a double edged blade that runs a bit over 7 inches in length.
ITEM.szBRDesc: If ever there was a fighting knife that just looks scary, it is the Fairbairn-Sykes Commando Knife. It is a double bladed dagger design, with a foil type grip and a double edged blade that runs a bit over 7 inches in length.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This full-tang bowie-styled combat knife will convert you into a whirling, twirling machine of silent, subtle death.
ITEM.szBRDesc: When the enemy is too close for comfort, this full-tang bowie-styled combat knife will definitely come in handy. It features a serrated 9" blade, and a wooden handle with a heavy-duty guard and pommel.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A poor man's substitute for a decent knife. Looks like nobody bothered to wash it after eating with it either.
Top of the line, this knife is corrosion resistant and keeps an edge forever.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Pearl Harbor seems to have been forgotten even by the toughest soldiers there are, as this knife for the U.S. Navy Seals is made in Japan.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This razor has a very sharp blade. In the right hands this is indeed a deadly weapon.
Shorter than a machete, but larger than most military knives.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The KaBar Cutlass is easier to handle than a machete, and looks more like the Nepalese Kukri, favored weapon of the famous Gurkha warriors.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A great big knife that looks like it came straight out of a Rambo movie. This thing looks big enough to use as a makeshift crowbar.
ITEM.szBRDesc: A great big knife that looks like it came straight out of a Rambo movie. Comes with "Entrail-Away" cleaning fluid.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This versatile tool combines a knife, a lockpick kit, wire cutters, a screw driver, scissors, a can opener, a cork screw and several other useful tools you never heard of.
Pry open locks and stab your enemies with this all purpose utility knife.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Pry open locks and stab your enemies with this all purpose utility knife.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The kukri is a curved Nepalese knife used as both tool and weapon. It is also a part of the regimental weaponry and heraldry of Gurkha fighters.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The kukri is a curved Nepalese knife used as both tool and weapon. It is also a part of the regimental weaponry and heraldry of Gurkha fighters.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Slice 'em, dice 'em, cook 'em 'n' clean 'em. Whether it be man, plant, or beast, this all purpose machete will chop any main course into the finest of cuts.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A very sturdy machete with an odd shape.
A cleaver is a large knife that varies in its shape but usually resembles a rectangular-bladed hatchet. It is largely used as a kitchen or butcher knife intended for hacking through bone.
The billhook is a traditional cutting tool used widely in agriculture and forestry for cutting smaller woody material such as shrubs and branches and is distinct from the sickle.
The balisong was commonly used by Filipino people, especially those in the Tagalog region, as a self-defense and pocket utility knife.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The balisong was commonly used by Filipino people, especially those in the Tagalog region, as a self-defense and pocket utility knife.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The balisong was commonly used by Filipino people, especially those in the Tagalog region, as a self-defense and pocket utility knife. If folded, the balisong is easily concealable.
Exactly what you'd need if you were going to cut through some cardboard. Pretty much useless in combat though.
This dual purpose machete solves two obstacles: chopping and sawing. Successful at both, the 18 inch blade features a full performance saw on one side, a 15 inch fine edge blade on the other.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This dual purpose machete solves two obstacles: chopping and sawing. Successful at both, the 18 inch blade features a full performance saw on one side, a 15 inch fine edge blade on the other.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This limited edition Sam Garver combat knife is authenticated with a serial number and signed by Sam himself. Its galvanized steel blade and gator-skin handle have made it a highly sought-after collectable.

From formal wear to fatigues, this highly versatile umbrella will accompany you anywhere in style. It is also extremely durable, boasting a teflon-treated cloth, guaranteed to withstand hail and sleet.

Based on the traditional Hudson Bay and French Biscay axes used by fur trappers and whalers in the 16th- through 18th-century, this hickory axe is comfortable to use for chopping wood and chopping people alike.
ITEM.szBRDesc: Based on the traditional Hudson Bay and French Biscay axes used by fur trappers and whalers in the 16th- through 18th-century, this hickory axe is comfortable to use for chopping wood and chopping people alike.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A Finnish made quality axe.
A typical heavy pioneer axe.

ITEM.szBRDesc: The Firefighter Axe has a pick-shaped pointed poll. Its primary use is for breaking down doors and windows.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A single-handed striking tool with a sharp blade on one side used to cut and split wood.
ITEM.szBRDesc: A single-handed striking tool with a sharp blade on one side used to cut and split wood. A great companion for any serious survivalist or simply a great tool for your next outdoor trip.

ITEM.szItemDesc: This axe is used to split you firewood down into more manageable sizes for camp fires, open fires and wood burners. Especially useful on large rounds, or large knotty wood.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This axe is used to split you firewood down into more manageable sizes for camp fires, open fires and wood burners. Especially useful on large rounds, or large knotty wood.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A brush hook is a gardening instrument resembling an axe, with a curved blade and a long handle. It is commonly used by surveying crews and firefighters to clear out heavy undergrowth from trails, as well as by homeowners and gardeners to clear thick brush.
As American as it gets.
A barbed wire enforced baseball bat is the perfect improvised weapon for any riot.
A rather crude blunt weapon.

A shillelagh or blackthorn stick is a wooden walking stick and club or cudgel, typically made from a stout knotty stick with a large knob at the top, that is associated with Ireland and Irish folklore.
ITEM.szBRDesc: A shillelagh or blackthorn stick is a wooden walking stick and club or cudgel, typically made from a stout knotty stick with a large knob at the top, that is associated with Ireland and Irish folklore.

ITEM.szItemDesc: A typical makeshift melee weapon of the trench wars.
ITEM.szBRDesc: A typical makeshift melee weapon of the trench wars.

ITEM.szBRDesc: Even though comparatively light weight, this flanged mace will make short work of any medieval plate armour and leave devestating wounds on the wearer.

A clawed hammer used by carpenters.
A heavy sledge hammer.
ITEM.szBRDesc: When it's Hammer Time and Mjölnir isn't available, take the next best thing!

ITEM.szItemDesc: Sometimes called a machinist's hammer, a ball peen is a good choice for working with metal. Its steel head is harder than that of a claw hammer, so is less likely to chip on impact.
A durable tool for fixing pipes and obnoxious people.
Perfect for digging your own grave, or hitting people over the head (and then dig their grave).
Perfect for digging your own grave, or hitting people over the head. It has astonishingly sharp edges, as if someone grinded them. Who might have had such a crazy idea?
Besides being used for digging defensive fighting positions, entrenching tools are used for digging latrines and graves.
A common farming tool.
Digging shovels are designed for doing just that.
A simple mining pick.
This durable lever tool is a one-piece bar of titanium. While harder and stronger than steel, it weighs less, and won't rust.
ITEM.szBRDesc: This titanium crowbar will come in handy when stuck in a jam. It's a one piece bar of titanium that's harder and stronger than steel, and corrosion resistant. Since it weighs almost nothing, you can take it anywhere.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The Hooligan bar is a multipurpose tool for prying, twisting, punching, or striking. It consists of a claw, a blade and a tapered pick, which is especially useful in quickly breaching many types of locked doors.
ITEM.szBRDesc: The Halligan bar is a multipurpose tool for prying, twisting, punching, or striking. It consists of a claw, a blade and a tapered pick, which is especially useful in quickly breaching many types of locked doors.

ITEM.szItemDesc: Putters are a special class of clubs with a loft not exceeding ten degrees, designed primarily to roll the ball along the grass, generally from a point on the putting green towards the cup.

An iron is a type of club used in the sport of golf to propel the ball towards the hole. Irons typically have shorter shafts and smaller clubheads than the woods, the head is made of solid iron or steel,
The 1-wood, or driver, is the lowest-lofted and longest club in a player's bag, and is meant to launch the ball the longest distance of any club.

ITEM.szBRDesc: This is one of the favoured weapons of Ninpo Taijutsu.

ITEM.szItemDesc: The HE incendiary, called the observation bullet by the Germans, had a pellet in it which exploded on contact with any target, however frail. The Germans maintained that it was used mainly for observation and range-finding, but observers report having seen them in rifle clips and machinegun belts.
